shortTeaser.raw: No other sector in Germany employs as few women as the construction industry.

teaser.raw: No other sector in Germany employs as few women as the construction industry. The few female construction workers face many challenges – including sexism. This report follows four of them.

title.raw: An electric truck hits the road for Norway

shortTeaser.raw: One missing buoy, one electric truck: Tobias Wagner tracks an unlikely journey to Norway.

teaser.raw: Trucker Tobias Wagner's mission: to get from Germany's East Frisia to Norway in an electric truck. A navigation buoy from the Juister Riff in the North Sea went missing and has turned up in Scandinavia.

title.raw: Who pays for the climate catastrophe?

shortTeaser.raw: Law students from the South Pacific have joined island nations to demand climate accountability.

teaser.raw: From their lecture halls to the International Court of Justice, law students from the South Pacific have joined island nations to demand greater climate accountability from industrialized countries.

shortTeaser.raw: BookTok grew from a pandemic trend into a major community for young romance readers.

teaser.raw: The digital book club BookTok started during the pandemic in 2020. Today, it is a big success, used primarily by young women who are fans of a particular genre - so-called "New Adult," or romance novels for young adults.

title.raw: The Dolomites —  summer in the Italian alps

shortTeaser.raw: From rugged peaks to gentle valleys, Italy's Dolomites are idyllic.

teaser.raw: From rugged peaks to gentle valleys, Italy's Dolomites are idyllic. In this film, nature lovers show us their mountain world and share fascinating stories about life between tradition and modernity.
